profile.headline: Software Engineer at HiARC
profile.summary: With over three years of experience, currently contributing to HiArc as a Software Engineer. Previously supported teams as a Software Project Manager at DEKA Research & Development and as a Senior Principal Software Engineer at BAE Systems, Inc., focusing on complex software solutions. Committed to building scalable, user-centric applications that align with organizational goals. Passionate about fostering collaboration and delivering impactful results through innovative technology solutions.

positions.title: Test/Quality Manager
positions.description:
- Head of the Test department for Massachusetts, U.S. and Mainz, Germany locations
- Responsible for the oversight, planning, and tasking for all test activities
- Development and maintenance of a software test automation framework and test cases to streamline end to end testing as well as enhance test coverage.
- Development and maintenance for test standards and processes across product lines.
